script_model_with_instances: use scripting_with_instances to convert a Detectron2 model into a TorchScript-compatible scripted model
trace_model_with_tracingadapter: use TracingAdapter to wrap a Detectron2 model and trace it with torch.jit.trace for deployment
dump_torchscript_IR: use dump_torchscript_IR to export a TorchScript model's IR and code to text files in a directory
flatten_to_tuple: use flatten_to_tuple to recursively flatten nested objects including Instances into a tuple of tensors with a reconstruction schema
test_rcnn_torchscript_export: run the TestScripting test suite to verify Mask R-CNN and RetinaNet models can be exported via TorchScript scripting
